narration.text: [whispers] This fire door is locked. Watch it. [long pause] [softly] Hampton Court Palace, England. October, two thousand three. Three days running, the same fire doors flew open by themselves. [long pause] Each time, a guard came to shut them. [long pause] On the second day, the security camera caught something else. [long pause] A figure in a long robe, with a pale face, stepped out of the doorway, and pulled the doors shut. [long pause] The palace released the footage. It has never explained it. [long pause] Skeptics say it was a visitor in costume. Or a prank. [long pause] No one was ever identified. [long pause] [whispers] Now look at camera three.
